en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Ziyad b. Ja`far al-Hamadani (ra) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim b. Hashim narrated to us from his father from al-Husayn b. al-Nawfali from Isma`il b. Abi Ziyad from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as) from his forefathers (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:
There is not a faster who attends to a people who are eating except that his appendages glorify [Allah]. The angels bless him, and their blessings are a repentance for him.
